clause_i.reason: For D_assign, an own-action-only policy q(I_t) cannot choose the seed-specific parcel and canton repair from its action history and task times alone; different generated visible maps can require different next edits.

clause_ii.reason: A zero-length recent window is sufficient for this static mechanic: the current screenshot exposes the parcel geometry, current canton colors and labels, guild marks, and canton seals, and no task-state evolution changes the delayed action.

clause_iii.reason: There is no autonomous non-clock task-state evolution between actions. The generator materializes the parcel map and assignments once; simplified assignment and undo mutate state only in click handlers, and certification only submits it. Waiting therefore supplies no H_t^tau in which an outcome-affecting action becomes unavailable or strictly less effective. CSS hover/selection transitions are presentation-only.

common_visible_process: None. The exact configuration has no visible autonomous task-state process shared by the clauses; the map and assignment remain unchanged while the agent supplies no action.

pre_run.reason: The mathematical classification is already No because clause (iii) fails. There is no autonomous outcome phase whose pre-run rate could override a mathematical Yes.

source_evidence.claim: Difficulty 3 is the 15-by-9, eight-displacement, 18-change profile; simplified mode is click-one-parcel then click-one-seal, and the configured observation window is 0 ms with one frame.
The runner uses a zero-millisecond observation window, one captured frame, a 240-second allowance, and synchronous execution.

The generator uses the assigned parameters to construct a fixed grid, warped partition, guild labels, initial assignment, and target assignment at generation time; the legacy difficulty-3 path displaces parcels once and returns materialized public and ground-truth state.

The simplified browser path selects a parcel on click, records an assignment only after a canton-seal click, and changes assignment on undo; the rendered model is initialized from initial_assignment and certification posts the current transcript.
The complete mechanic implementation contains no task timer, requestAnimationFrame loop, autonomous mutation, or action-started physical process.
The only timed visual effects are fill/hover/selection CSS transitions; they do not mutate assignment, budget, or grading state.

The grader replays only the submitted visible assignment/undo events, checks the static partition metrics, and treats certification as the final submitted outcome; it has no autonomous time evolution.
The task verifier loads the exported result and independently grades the replayed result, with no time-dependent task rule.

The frozen definition requires visible autonomous task-state evolution to make an action strictly less effective inside a positive delay; a static puzzle and presentation-only animation do not satisfy that requirement.

uncertainties: The controls file records a full/live baseline, but the assigned configuration is explicitly difficulty 3 with simplified interaction; this report follows the assigned configuration rather than the baseline.
